thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: release pipeline finished for release/2026.03.15 (sha d4c1f9a) - promotion to prod started

mike: saw a spike in 5xxs right after the canary. rolling back?

julia: getting a bunch of `ImagePullBackOff` on svc/model-serving-canary. logs show image digest mismatch.

ada: paging oncall — I'm getting customer reports of degraded inference latency and errors.

leah: I'm on it, oncall here. can anyone share the deploy command that ran?

mike: CI promoted `image: registry.redwood/models:latest` instead of the pinned digest. looks like our CD cache returned a stale tag.

julia: this smells like CI cache poisoning — the build reuse layer served an old manifest but the tag `latest` was updated in downstream registry.

leah: ok, kill the canary traffic first. applying feature flag kill-switch for model routing now.

leah: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/flags/toggle -d '{"flag":"model-serving.canary","state":false}'` -> 200

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0415-01 - Canary failed after promotion. Severity: P2. Assigned to leah.

mike: nice. also block further promotions from CI: `ci/deny-promotion --run=2026.03.15 --reason="suspected cache poisoning"`

julia: looking at artifacts — the job output shows `digest: sha256:abcd1234` but registry returns `sha256:fedc4321` for `latest`. checksum mismatch in registry response.

leah: starting a rollback of the canary to previous stable digest. `kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model=registry.redwood/models@sha256:stable0001 -n prod`

mike: pushing an emergency hotfix to pipeline: pin manifests to digest, invalidate CI cache keys. adding `ci/cache: invalidate` step.

julia: recording commands for postmortem: `gcloud container images describe registry.redwood/models:latest` shows updated manifest created at 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z which doesn't match build time. suspect a concurrent push during promotion.

leah: customer impact: some requests got 503s and increased latency for ~7 minutes before flag kill. estimated affected requests ~1200 across EU region. I've updated the incident doc with a preliminary impact note.

mike: alerting support and customers team: `@support` flagged for potential outages in EU inference.

deploy-bot: Deploy paused by user mike. Further promotions suspended until manual review.

julia: running a registry integrity check and contacting registry ops to fetch object storage logs for the conflicting manifests.

leah: after rollback, canary error rate down to baseline. can we run a verification job to re-run canary with pinned digest?

mike: yes — `ci/promote --image=registry.redwood/models@sha256:stable0001 --canary=true --verify=true` queued but gated behind manual approval.

julia: created a short-lived tag `staging-protect-20260315` and pushed digest to it to avoid `latest` surprises in the meantime. also adding pipeline step to assert `image == digest` before promote.

leah: handing off to night oncall (ada) in 20m. Ada, I'll DM the list of commands I ran and the incident doc link.

ada: thanks — please include registry ops contact and the CI job id. I'll follow up with a customer impact email draft overnight.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0415-01 updated: status=mitigated, mitigation="canary traffic disabled; rollback to stable digest".

mike: root cause hypothesis: CI cache returned a stale image manifest reference while a concurrent registry push updated the `latest` tag, leading to digest mismatch and ImagePull failures for some replicas.

julia: next steps: (1) invalidate CI cache keys for image promotion, (2) require digest pinning in promote jobs, (3) add registry manifest consistency check in CD, (4) postmortem + customer timeline.

leah: agree. I'm writing the incident timeline now. will create postmortem card and link to CI job logs. handing off to ada. :white_check_mark:

ada: got it — I'll monitor overnight and coordinate with registry ops in the morning. leaving this thread open for updates.

mike: thanks team. small note for the postmortem — capture the exact user-visible error messages and session ids for the affected customers.

julia: adding log snippet to incident doc:

```
ERROR: ImagePullBackOff: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image "registry.redwood/models:latest": failed to resolve reference: manifest checksum mismatch: expected sha256:abcd1234 got sha256:fedc4321
```

leah: closing the SLA impact assessment for now as P2. will reopen if new reports come in.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0415-01 - NOTE: postmortem required.

mike: 👍

ada: night team, ping me in the morning if anything spikes.

leah: handing over control in 10m. good work.

julia: copying commands to runbook: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving` and `ci/cache: invalidate --key model-promotion`

mike: end of thread — keeping thread for postmortem additions only.
